findings.title: Sparse activity is misreported as a consecutive week-over-week comparison
findings.what: Lines 169-177 sort only weeks having activity and select elements 1 and 2. If activity exists in nonconsecutive weeks, the returned currentWeekStart and previousWeekStart can be separated by multiple weeks even though the API and comments identify them as the last complete week and the immediately prior week. The resulting percentage is therefore not a true week-over-week delta.
findings.fix: Derive the compared Mondays by subtracting 7 and 14 days from the excluded trailing week, and read absent buckets as zero; alternatively reject the comparison unless the selected week starts are exactly seven days apart.
findings.acceptance: Add a test with activity in ISO weeks beginning 2026-01-05, 2026-01-19, and 2026-02-02. The function must not compare 2026-01-19 against 2026-01-05 as week-over-week; it must either compare the consecutive calendar weeks immediately preceding 2026-02-02 with missing buckets valued at zero or return null under an explicitly documented consecutive-week policy.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read of src/lib/weekly-delta.ts:110-177 confirmed that activeWeeks records only buckets receiving data and that no seven-day adjacency check or missing-week insertion occurs. The related test at src/lib/weekly-delta.test.ts:148 covers only the number of active weeks, not gaps between them.
